author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a new hand home, skips and steps, a pattern moved one key lower, walk and run-ning notes, and counting four.

classes.title: Thumb on B, next to C
classes.goal: Hear the song and rest five fingers on the five keys from B to F.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using C and the black keys to find where the hand lives

classes.parentPrompt: Find C left of the two black keys; help your child put the thumb one key further left.
classes.childAction: Find C, then put your thumb on B, just left of it.
classes.bridge: C is left of the two black keys; B is C's next-door neighbour, one more left.

intro.caption: Shoo, shoo, wave your hands
intro.parentCue: wave gently together with the song

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers together, one to five

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding a new hand home from B.

classes.title: Shoo! Skip down, buzz up
classes.goal: Play the first line: skip down from E to C, then step back up.

mathTarget.parentLine: One jump over a key, then small steps back up

classes.parentPrompt: Say the finger numbers aloud: four, two, three, four-five, four.
classes.childAction: Finger 4 skips to finger 2, then the fingers buzz back up.
classes.bridge: Shoo jumps the fly away over one key; then it buzzes back, step by step.

intro.caption: Shoo! Skip down, buzz up
intro.parentCue: Say the finger numbers aloud with each note

games.caption: Shoo, fly: skip and buzz
games.parentCue: Say 'skip' on C, 'buzz' on the quick notes

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a skip and steps with different fingers.

classes.title: The fly lands one key lower
classes.goal: Hear and play the second line: the same shape, one key lower.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same little tune, moved one key lower

classes.parentPrompt: Play line one, then line two; ask your child: same or different?
classes.childAction: Start one finger lower and play the very same shape.
classes.bridge: Same shape, one step to the left: the fly sits one key lower.

intro.caption: The fly lands one key lower
intro.parentCue: Ask: does it sound the same, but lower?

games.caption: Shoo fly, then one key lower
games.parentCue: Point one key left when the second line starts

games.caption: One key lower: D, B, C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: spotting the same pattern, one key lower.

classes.title: Three shoos and a march
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and count the shoo-fly lines before the new ending.

mathTarget.parentLine: Three lines that sound alike, then one new line

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up one finger for each shoo-fly line; on the last line, march your arms.
classes.childAction: Count the shoo-fly lines: one, two, three, then march!
classes.bridge: Shoo, shoo, shoo, then the last line climbs up high and marches home.

intro.caption: Three shoos and a march
intro.parentCue: Hold up a finger for each shoo-fly line

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting the parts of a song.

classes.title: Walk, walk, run-ning
classes.goal: Practise the quick pair of notes slowly, then a little faster.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two quick notes fit in the time of one walking note

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'walk' for the long notes and 'run-ning' for the two quick ones.
classes.childAction: Say walk and run-ning while your fingers play.
classes.bridge: Walking notes take one step; run-ning notes squeeze two steps in the same time.

games.caption: Walk, run-ning, stop
games.parentCue: Say walk, run-ning, stop with the lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one long note or two quick ones.

classes.title: Four beats, slow and even
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly, counting four beats in each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Beats come in groups of four: one, two, three, four

classes.parentPrompt: You play the high march line; your child taps and counts 1, 2, 3, 4.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and evenly while you count to four together.
classes.bridge: Each bar is a march of four steps: left, right, left, right.

intro.caption: Four beats, slow and even
intro.parentCue: Count one to four softly on the beats

games.caption: March and count to four
games.parentCue: You play this line; count four with each tap

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting four beats in a bar.

classes.title: Tiny fly up high
classes.goal: Move the hand to a higher B and play the song with the same fingers.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same song and fingers, moved to a higher home

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child find the next B to the right, then ask which sounds nicer.
classes.childAction: Move your thumb up to high B and play the same notes.
classes.bridge: Same hand shape, a new house to the right: a tiny fly buzzing high.

intro.caption: Watch: same song, up high
intro.parentCue: Find the next C to the right, then B

games.caption: Tiny fly sings up high
games.parentCue: Use a tiny buzzing voice together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: moving a song to a new place.

classes.title: Buzz along with the band
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your playing in time with the music

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the words along and nod on each beat; if a note slips, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play with the music and keep going to the end.
classes.bridge: The music is a bouncy walk-around; bounce along and keep going.

intro.caption: Play along
intro.parentCue: Sing the words softly with your child

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping in time with the music.

classes.title: Bouncy concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy with a light, bouncy touch, then bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song has a start, a middle and an end

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy in front; after the last note, wave a gentle 'shoo' and bow.
classes.childAction: Bow, play with bouncy fingers for teddy, then bow again.
classes.bridge: Light, bouncy fingers, like a fly dancing over the keys.

intro.caption: A song for teddy
intro.parentCue: Sit teddy in front and announce the song

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song lightly, start to end.
